item.title: How to Stop Balcony Drip Irrigation Runoff
item.description: How to Stop Balcony Drip Irrigation Runoff Short answer: shorten the cycle first, then check whether the water is coming from the pot, the tubing, the reservoir, or a tray that is too shallow. Balcony drip runoff is not just a plant problem. Water can drip through decking gaps, stain the floor, fill saucers, reach neighbors below, or make a renter-friendly system feel unsafe to leave on a timer. The fix is usually not a bigger kit.
